name: German Driving Theory Test (Class B)
fullName: German driving licence theory test, class B car (Führerschein Klasse B), in English

5.name: Vehicle, environment and fitness to drive

copy.guestPrompt: to save your progress for the theory test and keep track of every question you get wrong
copy.trainingSub: Each practice set covers one subject area of the test. You get instant feedback, and questions you get wrong come back until you know them.
copy.testsHeading: Practice tests · 30 questions, 2 mistakes at most
heroSubs: Five practice sets, seven practice tests. Start with Hazard awareness.
Master the set first, then take the test.
Keep going. Take a practice test to see where you stand.
Review your mistakes, then retake any test you haven't passed.
All green. Book your theory test.
copy.sourceLine: Based on the StVO, StVZO and Driving Licence Regulations (FeV) as of November 2026. Original questions, not from the official question catalogue; 30 per test, without error-point weighting.
